bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
source_path="$(grep -RFl --include='*userbot*.py' 'room_public_readback' scripts artifacts deploy 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"
test -n "$source_path" && test -f "$source_path" || exit 62
echo "RESIDENT_HANDLER_SOURCE=$source_path"
grep -nE 'room_public_readback|argparse|ArgumentParser|add_argument|def [a-zA-Z_]+|socket|client\.py|choices=' "$source_path" | head -n 95 || true
echo 'USERBOT_SOURCE_DISCOVERY=PASS'
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 63
